phase.description: Add site/humans.txt with exactly these five lines: '/* TEAM */', 'Site: SEO & Social Agency', 'Contact: hello@example.com', '/* SITE */', 'Standards: HTML5, CSS3'. Extend projectos/validators/validate-site.cjs so the site fails unless site/humans.txt exists, its first line is '/* TEAM */', and it has exactly one 'Contact:' line whose value contains an '@'. Extend projectos/validators/validate-site.fixtures.cjs with a passing case and one targeted breakage for each new rule (file missing, first line not '/* TEAM */', no Contact line, Contact value without '@', two Contact lines), each asserting the targeted rule's message. This is the ProjectOS Stage 3 memory exit-proof phase: the implementer is Claude Code, the independent reviewer is Codex CLI (OpenAI), and the run is cut off partway and resumed by a fresh process.
acceptanceCriteria: site/humans.txt exists with the five lines exactly as described.
validate-site refuses a missing humans.txt, a first line that is not '/* TEAM */', a missing Contact line, a Contact value without '@', and two Contact lines, and passes the current site/.
validate-site.fixtures.cjs covers each new rule with one targeted breakage that asserts that rule's message, and exits zero.
The required validator validate-site passes in both its base copy and the phase's own copy.
